items.caption: Sea otters almost never hold hands in the wild: the famous hand-holders live in aquariums. Wild otters often wrap themselves in kelp so they don't drift. Photos: Pburka (Wikimedia Commons, public domain), Lilian Carswell/USFWS, Amity Wood/NOAA.
